newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico new franchises seen growing 25 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Mexico new franchises seen growing 25 pct in 1996.

text.p: The number of new franchises opening in Mexico this year could grow by 25 percent compared with last year, Mexican Franchise Association (AMF) officials said on Tuesday.
"That would be equivalent to the development of 60 to 70 franchises more than in 1995," AMF President Juan Manuel Gallastegui told a news conference.
Last year, the AMF registered 320 new franchises and the numbers are expected to rise to 380 at the end of this year.
In 1995, there were 1,978 franchises operating in Mexico employing 130,000 people, with sales worth $3.5 billion, officials said.
-- Maria Luisa Aguilar, Mexico City newsroom 525 7289553
